name: api-test
description: Author strongly-typed TypeScript HTTP API tests with layered verification (status + schema contract + dual-service diff + state-machine anti-drift): resolves inputs via type definitions or read-only APIs first, runs deterministic gate, and repairs failures in a bounded loop

api_base_url.title: [Thin Orchestrator] 接口 Base URL (基线服务 Baseline)
api_base_url.placeholder: 如 http://127.0.0.1:8080（不含尾斜杠；系统有代理时记得设 API_NO_PROXY=*）

api_candidate_url.title: [Thin Orchestrator] 候选服务 URL (Candidate，可选对比)
api_candidate_url.placeholder: 如 http://127.0.0.1:8081（用于双服务对比时填写；单服务测试填 none）

api_auth_value.title: [Thin Orchestrator] 鉴权凭据值
api_auth_value.placeholder: JWT 请粘 token；请求头如 "X-Api-Key: abc"；多维如 "tenant_id=t1;user_id=u1"；无鉴权填 none

test_scope.title: [Thin Orchestrator] 测试范围
options: 业务全流程状态机链路(Pipeline Journey: Create->Approve->Claim->Execute->Report)
业务场景链测试(DAG Scenario Chains)
双服务对比与数据矩阵(Dual-Service Diffing)
全量业务场景与接口回归
test_scope.default: 业务全流程状态机链路(Pipeline Journey: Create->Approve->Claim->Execute->Report)

baseline_mode.title: [Thin Orchestrator] 数据基线对比（回归对比）
options: 自动：无基线则记录，有则对比
强制对比：缺基线即失败（CI）
baseline_mode.default: 自动：无基线则记录，有则对比

preChecks: bash -c 'command -v bun >/dev/null || command -v node >/dev/null || command -v npx >/dev/null'

steps.gateCmd: bash -c 'git diff --check || exit 1; if { git diff; git diff --cached; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard -z | xargs -0 cat 2>/dev/null; } | grep -Eqi "Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._-]{24,}|API_TOKEN=[A-Za-z0-9._-]{16,}"; then echo "SECRET LEAK: credential found in tracked diff or untracked files"; exit 1; fi; if git check-ignore -q .pi/api-tests/env.local.json || git check-ignore -q .pi/api-tests/env.local.sh; then :; else echo "MISSING: .pi/api-tests/ must be listed in .gitignore"; exit 1; fi; if [ -d tests/api/baselines ] && git check-ignore -q tests/api/baselines; then echo "MISSING: tests/api/baselines must be committed, not gitignored"; exit 1; fi; echo "author gate ok"'

bash -c 'if [ -f tests/api/runner.ts ]; then if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run tests/api/runner.ts; elif command -v tsx >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx tsx tests/api/runner.ts; else node --experimental-strip-types tests/api/runner.ts; fi; elif [ -f tests/api/run-api-tests.sh ]; then bash tests/api/run-api-tests.sh; else echo "No API test runner found"; exit 1; fi'
